people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.
translations.bsb: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.
translations.kjv: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
translations.asv: And David commanded to gather together the sojourners that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
